name: cuttrack
description: CutTrack - full-stack fitness & calorie deficit tracker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src=fs.existsSync('client/dist')?'client/dist':(fs.existsSync('dist')?'dist':null); if(src){ ['public','dist','client/dist'].forEach(d=>{ if(d!==src) fs.cpSync(src,d,{recursive:true}); }); }"
